$description: Color / Active — brand mode. All values alias the 'brand' family from Semantic / Color. Apply this mode to a frame/component to make it brand-colored (primary, CTA). Use in Figma by setting the 'Color / Active' collection mode to 'brand'.

color.$description: Primary accent fill for brand components (e.g. primary button bg)

on-color.$description: Text/icon color drawn on top of 'color'

container.$description: Subtle tinted background for brand-colored containers

focus.$description: Focus ring color (semi-transparent) for brand-colored components
